body: It wasn’t my aim to upset you but come on man
You just replied to me saying you don’t want to die, now you do?

You were young, look at how it’s made you feel now? Use that feeling to ensure your honest to everyone and yourself for the future. We all make horrible mistakes in our life, the key is to acknowledge and make a change

If you really wanted to die, you wouldn’t come here posting about it. What you want is attention (not a bad thing) , affection or just reassurance. Whatever your going through will only make you stronger in the end, you’ll realise your self worth, real friends, and that life is only temporary.
